name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for historic-home restoration?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for historic-home restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor, gather any available historical documents, photographs, or architectural plans of your home. It's also helpful to have a clear idea of your restoration goals, your budget, and a prioritized list of areas you wish to address. Consider what aspects of your home's original character you wish to emphasize, such as specific architectural details in a Rockridge bungalow, to effectively communicate your vision to potential contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare historical documents, photos, architectural plans, and a clear idea of your restoration goals, budget, and priority areas before contacting a contractor.
